_comment: THEME-LOCK.json — generated by Phase UI-1. All values are locked. The check:theme script enforces this file at build time.

tokens._note_gradients: Gradients may only blend locked tokens or lower-opacity variants of them.

forbiddenPatterns.rawHexOutsideTokens: Any 6-digit hex (#RRGGBB) or rgb() value NOT present in the colors table above (opacity variants allowed: rgba() of a locked hex, or oklch/hsl only when converting a locked token).
forbiddenPatterns.newFontFamilies: Any font-family value other than 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Inter', 'Noto Sans Gujarati', 'system-ui', or 'sans-serif'.
forbiddenPatterns.darkMode: Any @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block, class 'dark:', or attribute 'data-theme' with value 'dark'.
forbiddenPatterns.logoFileChange: Any change to SHA-256 hashes of the logo files listed above.
